routing._comment: offline_only above forces every stage (Describe/Plan/Execute/Review) through ollama only, at zero cost, regardless of this order. There is no Anthropic API provider in this project on purpose — if you want to use Claude Code against this same Ollama setup, run ./setup-claude-code.sh instead, which drives the real Claude Code CLI directly against Ollama with no Anthropic account, login, or API key involved anywhere. openrouter/deepseek/grok above are optional cloud fallback, off by default, only ever used if you add real keys and set offline_only to false. auto_continue chains resumes automatically past max_iterations, up to max_total_iterations as a hard safety ceiling, so a build doesn't stall waiting for a manual Continue click.
